notes: Deterministic sampling for the pilot corpus. 'every_nth_day' takes the 1st day of the range (plus start_offset_days) and then every n-th day after it, and downloads ALL bulletins of those days. The alternative rule 'random_days' (needs 'k' and uses 'seed') picks k days with random.Random(seed). The seed is saved in the sample plan even when the rule does not use it.

rule: Strata = month (Aug, Sep, Oct) x {weekday, weekend}. Option B quotas: weekend 2 per month; weekdays Aug 6, Sep 5, Oct 5 (22 days).

Strata are visited in order (month ascending, weekday before weekend). Within a stratum days are shuffled with random.Random(42) and accepted if no two chosen days are consecutive calendar days (|gap| >= 2), which limits story overlap between splits.
Option A is nested inside option B: the first k days drawn per stratum (weekend 1 per month; weekdays Aug 2, Sep 2, Oct 3 = 10 days). Extending A to B never changes A's days or A's split.

Split by WHOLE DAYS only. A: 6 train / 2 val / 2 test, shuffled with random.Random(42) until test has >=1 weekend day, >=1 weekday and 2 different months, and val spans >=2 months. B keeps A's assignment and adds 12 days (8 train, 2 val, 2 test) under the same seeded rejection rule (test must cover all 3 months with a weekend and a weekday). The explicit day lists below are the source of truth and must not be re-drawn.

Duplicate-slot pairs (two different audio files, same date and same parsed HHMM) are not a selection criterion; checked after selection: A has 8 of 10 days with a pair, B has 19 of 22. Whether the two files of a pair have identical content is UNVERIFIED.
